title: Line Crew Safety Practice: Site Inspection Charge when Reconnecting Electric Service by Rate Schedule after Disconnection
content:
**Practice.** A meter that has stood disconnected for some days is inspected on reconnection, and the reconnection of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account adds a site inspection charge to the reconnect fee according to how long the meter has stood disconnected. The days are calendar days counted from the disconnect date recorded on the service account to the current date.

| Calendar days disconnected | Site inspection charge |
|---|---|
| 14 or more | $30.00 |
| 3 to 13 | $15.00 |
| 0 to 2 | Nothing |

The charge is added to the crew charge in the reconnect fee, and the total is rounded to the cent.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical; disconnect date May 4)

| Reconnection date | Days disconnected | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| May 6 | 2 | Nothing |
| May 7 | 3 | $15.00 |
| May 17 | 13 | $15.00 |
| May 18 | 14 | $30.00 |
